# AutoSugges agent packs

Instruction packs that teach a coding agent to add AutoSugges autocomplete (React, Next.js, JavaScript (no framework), Expo / React Native) correctly: publishable key as a query parameter, minimum 2 characters, 150 ms debounce, typed error handling. Queries only: no pack asks an agent to download a list. Full docs: https://docs.autosugges.com.

| Agent | Install |
| --- | --- |
| Claude Code plugin (skill + MCP) | `/plugin marketplace add autosugges/autosugges-js` then `/plugin install autosugges@autosugges` |
| Claude Code skill only | copy `skills/autosugges/` to `~/.claude/skills/autosugges/` (or `.claude/skills/` in a project) |
| Codex, Jules, Copilot agent | append `AGENTS.md` to your repo-root `AGENTS.md` |
| Cursor | copy `cursor/autosugges.mdc` to `.cursor/rules/autosugges.mdc` |
| Windsurf | copy `windsurf/autosugges.md` to `.windsurf/rules/autosugges.md` |
| GitHub Copilot | append `copilot/copilot-instructions.md` to `.github/copilot-instructions.md` |
| Context7 | copy `context7.json` to the repository root, then submit the repo at https://context7.com |
| Any MCP client | `npx -y @autosugges/mcp` with `AUTOSUGGES_PUBLISHABLE_KEY` set; see the MCP section in each pack |

Get a free publishable key at https://app.autosugges.com.
